messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok

messages.text: my friend asked if she could join the lesson one time to watch

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Probably better not, the room is small and she might distract you. You can play for her at the recital.

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok that's fine

messages.text: but my friends are in it and it's fun

messages.text: Your friends aren't going to help you get to grade 5. I am. Maybe skip it this week and just tell your mum you're tired

messages.speaker: child

messages.text: Chloe，我聽講你星期六同同學去咗學校樂團 practice？

messages.text: 咁你琴呢？我同你講過，你而家係好關鍵嘅階段，唔好分心

messages.text: it was only for an hour

messages.text: 我等緊你答

messages.text: ok

messages.text: 明
